name: Kimpton Tsim Sha Tsui Hong Kong
positioning: Kimpton hotel in Tsim Sha Tsui with Victoria Harbour views in every guestroom, five restaurants and bars, and a heated rooftop pool
best_for: Travelers who want harbour views from every room
Food and cocktail lovers who like several restaurants and bars under one roof

facts.text: All guestrooms have Victoria Harbour views through expansive windows.
JIJA is an independent Chinese bistro inspired by Yunnan-Guizhou flavors.
Birdsong serves Elephant Grounds coffee and artisanal sandwiches.
Hillside serves a breakfast buffet by day and modern dai pai dong dining at night.
The rooftop pool area has sunbeds and private cabanas.
Pets are welcome, with rooms on a pet floor that allow one cat or dog.
Children receive special amenities including slippers, shampoo, shower gel and toothbrushes.
The building has a flying V shape.
The Kimpton Harbour Suites have a sunken jacuzzi next to the bedroom window.

highlights.text: JIJA is helmed by chef Vicky Lau, founder of Tate Dining Room.
Swim Club is a poolside cocktail bar on the 50th floor.
The hotel has a heated rooftop infinity pool.
Birdsong, the lobby lounge and bar, is a double-height space with mid-century-style terrazzo floors, starburst chandeliers and pink velvet chairs.
A daily social hour offers complimentary wine, fruit punch and canapes.

considerations.text: There is no local area shuttle at the hotel.
The hotel is described as better suited to grown-ups, though families are welcome.
WhataHotel notes a dense urban environment with limited quiet outdoor spaces.
